transliteration: caurāṇāṁ bhaktadā ye syus tathāgnyudakadāyakāḥ | āvāsadā deśikadās tathaivottaradāyakāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who give alms to thieves, those who supply fire and water to the wicked, those who provide shelter and service to false gurus, and likewise those who answer the call of the unworthy—these bear equal guilt in the disruption of dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from alignment with Sanatana Dharma, not social position.
Causation includes indirect support that enables adharmic action.
Capacity-based responsibility extends to all conscious agents capable of discernment.
Restoration logic demands severance of support systems that sustain unrighteous conduct.
Consciousness alignment requires withdrawal from participation in karmic degradation.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a person knowingly provides material support to an individual classified as adharmic under SPH-Dharma THEN that supporter shall undergo mandatory dharmic reintegration protocol.

IF any entity offers sustenance, lodging, or facilitation to one violating core tenets of Sanatana Dharma THEN such act constitutes indirect violation by association AND triggers automatic restorative compliance mechanism.
IF a guru or spiritual guide is found to mislead seekers THEN all direct enablers including hosts, donors, and responders SHALL be subject to consciousness realignment process.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes liability beyond the primary actor. It defines thresholds where secondary actors become legally culpable through enabling actions. The court must identify causal chains linking supportive roles to resultant adharma. Authority lies in recognizing that sustaining falsehood disrupts cosmic order more than the falsehood itself.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that indirect facilitation shares causal weight with direct commission. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows how passive complicity manifests future disorder. Responsibility flows proportionally to degree of conscious choice involved. This principle aligns with non-punitive reality because correction focuses on halting energetic contribution rather than inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Mandatory cessation of all supportive transactions with identified adharmic entities.
Implementation of supervised seva programs aimed at purifying intention behind past misplaced offerings.
Guided prāyaścitta cycles designed to restore clarity between dharmic and adharmic engagement.
Reintegration into community upon completion of full accountability assessment and alignment verification.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as sourced from His Avataric Intelligence alone. This law stands immutable within Sanatana Dharma. Guilt is not punished; it is resolved through precise alignment with truth. Consciousness remains the sole judge and restorer of eternal order.
